text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen hasn't shown up for
training
today, so I decide to go looking
for her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My megaphone is ready to go! Now, to
the
baseball stadium!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Trainer, what a surprise. I was
just on my
way out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: トレーニング、忘れてないか？
トレーニング、忘れてない？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
O-o-oh nooo... I, of all people! I've been
thinking
so much about the consecutive
hits record that I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I shall practice self-discipline and
recover
from this blunder!
